clips.send: A square garden has an area of 25 square metres. How long is each side?
clips.text: A square garden has an area of 25 square metres. How long is each side?

clips.send: Count along the bottom: 5 tiles, because 5 times 5 equals 25 . The side length is the square root of the area: the square root of 25 equals 5 , since 5 squared equals 25 .
clips.text: Count along the bottom: 5 tiles, because 5 times 5 = 25. The side length is the square root of the area: sqrt 25 = 5, since 5 2 = 25.

clips.send: Worked example: solve x squared equals 40 , so x equals plus or minus the square root of 40 . Since 36 is less than 40 is less than 49 , the square root of 40 is between 6 and 7, and closer to 6. Check: 6.3 squared equals 39.69 , so the square root of 40 is about 6.3 .
clips.text: Worked example: solve x 2 = 40, so x = pm sqrt 40 . Since 36 < 40 < 49, sqrt 40 is between 6 and 7, and closer to 6. Check: 6.3 2 = 39.69, so sqrt 40 approx 6.3.

clips.send: How long is the square root of 2 ? Swing the diagonal down onto the number line. Since 1 squared equals 1 is less than 2 is less than 4 equals 2 squared , it must land between 1 and 2.
clips.text: How long is sqrt 2 ? Swing the diagonal down onto the number line. Since 1 2 = 1 < 2 < 4 = 2 2, it must land between 1 and 2.

clips.send: Fractions behave differently: their decimals either end ( 1 over 4 equals 0.25 ) or repeat ( 1 over 7 equals 0.142857 ). Those are rational numbers. Numbers like the square root of 2 and pi cannot be written as a fraction: they are irrational.
clips.text: Fractions behave differently: their decimals either end ( tfrac14 = 0.25) or repeat ( tfrac17 = 0. overline 142857 ). Those are rational numbers. Numbers like sqrt 2 and pi cannot be written as a fraction: they are irrational.

clips.send: Keep zooming: 1.41, then 1.414, … Every zoom reveals one more digit, and it never stops: the square root of 2 equals 1.41421356 and so on The digits never end and never settle into a repeating pattern.
clips.text: Keep zooming: 1.41, then 1.414, … Every zoom reveals one more digit, and it never stops: sqrt 2 = 1.41421356 ldots The digits never end and never settle into a repeating pattern.

clips.send: Squares of whole numbers, 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, and so on are called perfect squares. Their square roots are whole numbers: the sides 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.
clips.text: Squares of whole numbers, 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, ldots are called perfect squares. Their square roots are whole numbers: the sides 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.

clips.send: The same idea works in 3D. A cube with volume 27 has edge 3, because 3 times 3 times 3 equals 27 . So the cube root is sqrt[3]27 equals 3 .
clips.text: The same idea works in 3D. A cube with volume 27 has edge 3, because 3 times 3 times 3 = 27. So the cube root is sqrt[3] 27 = 3.

clips.send: Zoom in. 1.4 squared equals 1.96 is a bit less than 2, and 1.5 squared equals 2.25 is more, so the square root of 2 is between 1.4 and 1.5. The first decimal digit is 4.
clips.text: Zoom in. 1.4 2 = 1.96 is a bit less than 2, and 1.5 2 = 2.25 is more, so sqrt 2 is between 1.4 and 1.5. The first decimal digit is 4.

clips.send: Now a puzzle: which square has area 2? Cut two unit squares along their diagonals and slide two halves down. The four pieces form a tilted square of area 2, so its side is the square root of 2 : the diagonal of a unit square.

clips.send: 沿底边数一数：5 块，因为 5 乘 5 等于 25 。边长就是面积的平方根： 根号25 等于 5 ，因为 5的平方 等于 25 。
clips.text: 沿底边数一数：5 块，因为 5 times 5 = 25。边长就是面积的平方根： sqrt 25 = 5，因为 5 2 = 25。

clips.send: 一块正方形菜地的面积是 25 平方米。它的每条边有多长？
clips.text: 一块正方形菜地的面积是 25 平方米。它的每条边有多长？

clips.send: 分数就不一样了：它们的小数要么是有限小数（ 4分之1 等于 0.25 ），要么是循环小数（ 7分之1 等于 0.142857 ），这些都是有理数。像 根号2 、 派 这样不能写成分数的数，叫作无理数。
clips.text: 分数就不一样了：它们的小数要么是有限小数（ tfrac14 = 0.25），要么是循环小数（ tfrac17 = 0. overline 142857 ），这些都是有理数。像 sqrt 2 、 pi 这样不能写成分数的数，叫作无理数。

clips.send: 同样的想法也适用于立体。体积为 27 的正方体，棱长是 3，因为 3 乘 3 乘 3 等于 27 。所以 27 的立方根 sqrt[3]27 等于 3 。
clips.text: 同样的想法也适用于立体。体积为 27 的正方体，棱长是 3，因为 3 times 3 times 3 = 27。所以 27 的立方根 sqrt[3] 27 = 3。

clips.send: 现在来个难题：面积为 2 的正方形是什么样？把两个单位正方形沿对角线剪开，把其中两半滑下来。四块拼成一个斜放的正方形，面积是 2，所以它的边长是 根号2 ——正好是单位正方形的对角线。

clips.send: 根号2 有多长？把对角线“转”到数轴上。因为 1的平方 等于 1 小于 2 小于 4 等于 2的平方 ，它一定落在 1 和 2 之间。
clips.text: sqrt 2 有多长？把对角线“转”到数轴上。因为 1 2 = 1 < 2 < 4 = 2 2，它一定落在 1 和 2 之间。

clips.send: 放大。 1.4的平方 等于 1.96 比 2 小一点， 1.5的平方 等于 2.25 比 2 大，所以 根号2 在 1.4 和 1.5 之间，第一位小数是 4。
clips.text: 放大。1.4 2 = 1.96 比 2 小一点，1.5 2 = 2.25 比 2 大，所以 sqrt 2 在 1.4 和 1.5 之间，第一位小数是 4。

clips.send: 整数的平方 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, …… 叫作完全平方数。它们的平方根都是整数：边长 1、2、3、4、5。
clips.text: 整数的平方 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, ldots 叫作完全平方数。它们的平方根都是整数：边长 1、2、3、4、5。
